action.objective: Activate the bishop to f4, keeping it on the a7-g1 diagonal while it controls e5/g5 and stays out of the rook's immediate reach.
action.rationale: Bf4 is the only commit_ready move. Single-candidate verification completed at depth 4 (exact 428), safety complete with no mating reply and tactical_refutation not_found. It keeps R+B+2P vs R+2P, attacks g5/e5, covers c1 and h6, and avoids Rxf3/Rxa3 working against a defended bishop. The depth-3 bounded 444 for Bf8 is shallower, not clearly better.
